{{Quote|Impressive. Gregor, your designation is CC-5576-39. You were a captain and part of an elite squad; a clone commando. The file says you were reported missing in action during the Battle of Sarrish.|Colonel Gascon|<ref name="MIA" />}}
'''Gregor''', designated '''CC-5576-39''', was a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] who served as a [[Clone Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He suffered [[Amnesia/Legends|amnesia]] when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] forces were [[Battle of Sarrish/Legends|defeated]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarrish/Legends|Sarrish]]. Gregor eventually ended up on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]], where the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Borkus/Legends|Borkus]] took advantage of the [[Cloning/Legends|clone's]] lack of memory and employed him as a [[Dishwasher/Legends|dishwasher]] at [[Power Sliders/Legends|his diner]]. However, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]] and the [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]], who were searching for a way back to the Republic after recovering a Confederate [[Encryption module/Legends|encryption module]], helped Gregor gain his memory back and convinced him to aid their mission. The clone commando distracted the forces at the local [[Rhydonium mining installation/Legends|Rhydonium mining installation]] while Gascon and the D-Squad [[Escape from Abafar/Legends|escaped]] Abafar.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Do... do you remember how you escaped Sarrish?''"<br />"''No. I just remember seeing all those... bodies. Bodies everywhere.|Colonel Gascon and Gregor|<ref name="MIA" />}}
[[File:Borkus_lying_to_Gregor.png|thumb|left|220px|Gregor converses with his employer, Borkus]]
Unit CC-5576-39, known by the nickname "Gregor," was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. He was [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] from the template of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], and received training as a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]], earning the rank of [[Clone Captain/Legends|captain]]. He served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="MIA" /> as part of the [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]]<ref name="Guide">''[[Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic]]'' states that all [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] were part of the [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]].</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|launched]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[20 BBY/Legends|Two years later]],<ref name="Note">The [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] ''[[Routine Valor]]'' established that the events of the [[Battle of Sarrish/Legends|Battle of Sarrish]] took place in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> Gregor and [[Foxtrot Group/Legends|his squad]] were part of the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]],<ref name="Gregor" /> and participated in the Republic's [[Battle of Sarrish/Legends|assault]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] on the planet [[Sarrish/Legends|Sarrish]],<ref name="MIA" /> during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]].<ref name="Note" /> The forces of the Republic suffered severe casualties during the battle, and Gregor, who tried to find help for his fellow [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], suffered amnesia and ended up on a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. The shuttle carrying him crashed on the planet [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]], which was also in the Outer Rim, and a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] named [[Borkus/Legends|Borkus]], who owned the [[Power Sliders/Legends|Power Sliders]] diner in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora]], rescued Gregor. The commando's lack of memory was taken advantage of by Borkus, who employed the clone as a [[Dishwasher/Legends|dishwasher]] in the diner. Borkus also owned an [[6C/Legends|apartment]] that he rented to Gregor.<ref name="MIA" />

Eventually, the [[Zilkin/Legends|Zilkin]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]], [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]] and the [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|pit droid]] [[WAC-47/Legends|WAC-47]]&mdash;who along with the other members of the [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]], were searching for a way to [[Escape from Abafar/Legends|escape]] Abafar and reach the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]&mdash;entered Power Sliders looking for nourishment. After Borkus refused to serve the duo, Gregor encountered Gascon and WAC-47 in the back of the diner searching through the garbage. After Gregor offered the Zilkin something to eat, Gascon recognized the amnesiac as a clone, confirming his suspicions with further inspection. Gregor was commanded by Gascon, who believed he was on an undercover mission, to aid them. However, Gregor returned to work when Borkus called for him, leaving Gascon and WAC-47 in the alley. After Borkus closed the diner for the day, Gregor questioned him about his own identity, and the Sullustan brushed the questions off and told Gregor not to ask about them again.<ref name="MIA" />

After arriving at his apartment, Gregor encountered a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of the clone captain [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], and was confronted by Gascon and the members of the D-Squad, who attempted to jog his memory. Gregor only remembered waking up on a transport ship and crashing on Abafar, and also recalled Borkus rescuing him. Gregor's left wrist, which was marked with an [[Identifying code/Legends|identifying code]], was scanned by the astromech [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to reveal the amnesiac soldier's unit number, rank and status as a clone commando. Gregor began to vaguely recall the events of the Battle of Sarrish, and Gascon convinced Gregor to join them in completing their mission. After he trimmed his [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and shaved his beard, Gregor, Gascon, and the droids went to Power Sliders, where the commando believed his [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|armor]] and equipment were being kept by Borkus. As Gregor and the D-Squad were searching for his equipment at the diner, Borkus confronted them and threatened Gregor with his [[DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System/Legends|DC-17 blaster rifle]]. The Sullustan informed them that the Separatists were [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Rhydonium/Legends|rhydonium]], a volatile fuel, in order to destroy the [[Renown/Legends|Republic cruiser]] in Abafar's orbit. When Gregor tried to grab the weapon from Borkus, the Sullustan hit the commando and taunted him; however; Borkus was disarmed and restrained by the D-Squad.<ref name="MIA" />

[[File:GregorOneManArmy-MIA.png|thumb|220px|Gregor firing at battle droids shortly before his sacrifice]]
Gregor, Gascon, and the droids headed to the local [[Rhydonium mining installation/Legends|Rhydonium mining installation]]. After verifying Borkus's claims, Gregor told the Colonel and the droids to head straight for the [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|attack shuttle]] as he covered their escape. The commando began to dispatch the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] guarding the facility, targeting various barrels of rhydonium in order to destroy the facility's operations and to provide cover for the D-Squad. When Gascon and the astromech [[M5-BZ/Legends|M5-BZ]] were separated from the group, Gregor retrieved them and provided more cover fire. As the D-Squad made their escape aboard the shuttle, Gregor targeted more of the rhydonium barrels as he was being overrun by the droid forces, resulting in the facility's destruction. The Colonel promised that Gregor's sacrifice would not be forgotten and he and D-Squad would watch for his return to the Republic.<ref name="MIA" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|He's doing what a soldier does: sacrificing himself for the lives of others.|Colonel Gascon to WAC|<ref name="MIA" />}}
[[File:Gregor-TCWs5BR2.png|thumb|left|250px|Gregor prior to shaving, and in his commando armor]]
When Meebur Gascon discovered Gregor, he was confused and not very confident and spoke in a low voice. He thought Borkus was doing a good thing for him by letting him get an apartment and work as a dishwasher for money. When Gregor asked what a clone was, Borkus told them they were brave and skilled soldiers and that was something Gregor was not. As D-Squad began to reassemble, Gregor's personality changed. He became confident and spoke louder in a brave and proud voice. He then realize Borkus was treating him like a slave, and became a proud soldier for the Republic once again. He was brave and daring enough to go on the task to destroy entire mining facility and a whole battalion of droids and even promise his superiors that he would return. He also put other lives before his own and let D-Squad escape while he stayed to fight.

As a clone commando with advanced training, Gregor was extremely proficient with weapons, and managed to take on an entire base full of droids by himself, destroying super battle droids, droidekas and battle droids using his wit and skill, only becoming surrounded after breaking position to save the Colonel. Gregor possessed excellent accuracy compared to his clone brethren, being able to shoot droids in the head while jumping and running from cover to cover.

Gregor appears to be proud of his achievements in destroying droids prior to his amnesia, as he openly keeps a tally of his droid kill count on his helmet.

==Equipment==
[[File:FoxtrotGroup-MIA.png|112x112px|right|thumb|The emblem on "Gregor's" armor]]
Gregor wore [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|''Katarn''-class commando armor]] with digital camo and yellow/orange markings, representing his membership in the [[212th Attack Battalion]]. He carried a DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System for a weapon. His helmet featured tally marks to represent the number of droids he had destroyed: they tallied up to 250, the most of any clone who was seen tallying their droid kill count.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Clone_identifying_code.png|alt=Hologram showing "Gregor - 557-39. SGT 1ST Class. Fox-Trot Group. Height 6ft. Weight 178. Status MIA Battle of Sarrish"|thumb|Gregor's [[Identifying code]]]]
Gregor made his first appearance in "[[Missing in Action]]," an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. The preview clip that Gregor appears in was shown at [[Celebration VI]]. He is voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]]. In a Season 5 trailer of the Clone Wars, the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] that displays on Gregor's profile notes that he went missing in action during the Battle of Sarrish.<ref name="trailer">{{SW|url=video/star-wars-the-clone-wars-season-5-trailer|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars Season 5 Trailer}}</ref>

During the episode, a hologram showing Gregor's military records was displayed in [[Aurebesh]] after [[R2-D2]] scanned his identifying code. As well as displaying Gregor's status as MIA during the [[Battle of Sarrish]], it displayed '[[Sergeant/Legends|SGT 1st Class]]', '212 Attack Battalion' (most likely referring to the 212th Attack Battalion) and 'Foxtrot Group', as well as Gregor's height and weight.<ref name="MIA" /> The designation of SGT 1st Class contradicts [[Meebur Gascon|Colonel Gascon]] stating that Gregor was Captain, despite the fact that Gascon was going off of the hologram.

Gregor's helmet markings are based on the hash-marks that [[Wikipedia:Boston Bruins|Boston Bruins]] goaltender [[Wikipedia:Gerry Cheevers|Gerry Cheevers]] stenciled on his mask to denote the stitches he would have gotten had he not been wearing protective gear.<ref name="trivia">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep512|text="Missing in Action" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>
